description: This file defines the IoStream interface for physical bi-directional communication, extending WriteStream, with methods to manage input listeners, connection state, and data purging.

classes.name: IoStream
classes.description: Interface for a bi-directional communication stream, allowing setting of input listener, checking if closed, closing the stream, and purging data.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets a DataListener that will be invoked from an implementation-dependent thread.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks whether the stream is closed.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purges pending input and output data.
